summary: Iteration 6 verifies the 4 new features (forgot-password, privacy notice, lead consent, firm dashboard, store-link gating). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (xdist loadscope, ~10s). Privacy: GET /api/privacy returns version '2026-10-draft-1' + 7 sections mentioning 'SFL Wealth Management' and 'Rosemount'; register without privacy_accepted -> 400 'Please read and accept the privacy notice...'; with privacy_accepted true -> 200 and user doc stores privacy_version + privacy_accepted_at. Consent: POST /api/leads without consent -> 400 'Please tick the box...'; with consent -> 200 and lead doc has non-empty consent_text (includes adviser name 'Mark') + consent_at. Forgot password: unknown email returns 200 generic '6-digit' message (no enumeration); known email also returns the same generic response and creates a db.password_resets doc with code_hash (sha256) + attempts=0, NO plaintext code stored; email send fails with 'Undeliverable recipient' (known billing/sandbox) but endpoint response is unaffected. Rate limit: 3 reset requests/email/hour returns 429 on 4th. /api/auth/reset-password: wrong code -> 400 and attempts++; after 5 wrong attempts even correct code fails (lockout); expired reset -> 400; correct code (hash matched via sha256(f'{JWT_SECRET}:{uid}:{code}')) -> 200 with token+user, bumps password_version (old token now 401 on /auth/me), reset doc deleted (single use), login with new password succeeds. Firm dashboard: GET /api/firm/stats as Mark (firm admin) returns totals {clients, checks, leads, new, contacted, closed} as ints, advisers list containing MARK-SFL, by_source list; non-admin adviser (newly created, after mandatory password change) -> 403; client -> 403. Store links: GET /api/start and GET /api/invite/MARK-SFL return HTML containing 'Coming soon' while IOS_APP_URL/ANDROID_APP_URL are empty. Regression: tom@example.com/test1234 login + /api/assessments OK; Mark /adviser/stats + /adviser/leads 200; /auth/change-password rejects wrong current with 400 (Mark's password unchanged). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): /auth login mode shows auth-forgot-password; tapping it navigates to forgot-password-screen with forgot-email-input + forgot-send-code visible; /auth register mode shows auth-privacy-checkbox + auth-open-privacy + auth-name-input + auth-submit-button; /privacy renders privacy-screen with SFL Wealth and Rosemount text present. Cleanup: all TEST_* users + their leads + db.rate_limits + db.password_resets removed at module teardown; Mark and Tom passwords untouched.
action_items: server.py is now 821 lines; recommend splitting /auth, /firm, /adviser, /invite|/start into routers/ modules (flagged iteration 5, still outstanding).

Email delivery to mark.turner@sflwealth.co.uk now returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient' from the Emergent email provider (not just insufficient credits). Lead-created endpoint still returns 200 with email_sent=false, and forgot-password still returns the generic 200 response, so this is non-blocking - but main agent may want to switch ADVISER_EMAIL to a sandbox-accepted address (e.g. delivered+mark@resend.dev) for tests, or document that outbound email is expected to fail in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (one-line) during this run: server.py line 165-181 Lead model was missing a `source` field, so `Lead(source=user.signup_source, ...)` at line 676 silently dropped it (Pydantic default extra='ignore'), then `lead.source` at line 720 raised AttributeError, making GET /api/adviser/leads return 500 as soon as Mark had any leads. Added `source: str = ""` to the model. This also means Lead docs stored before this fix will still read as source='' - acceptable since source_code is already persisted and source_label() falls back to 'Adviser code'/'No code' based on code. Recommend a one-off migration later to backfill source from source_code suffix if campaign reporting matters historically.

forgot_password builds the email HTML with the plaintext 6-digit code and relies entirely on email delivery for the user to see it. In the current preview env emails never arrive, so the only path to test the full UX is to insert password_resets docs directly. Consider logging the code to a secret dev-only sink gated by an env flag (not DEBUG, not in prod).

_code_hash uses sha256(f"{JWT_SECRET}:{user_id}:{code}"). JWT_SECRET is a 64-hex-char value from .env, high entropy. Code is a 6-digit secrets.randbelow(1_000_000) which is 20 bits - acceptable because the lockout is 5 attempts and 15 min TTL (prob ~0.0005%).

reset-password returns 400 on any failure branch (no user / no reset / locked / expired / wrong) with the same message - good, no enumeration. BUT: the request body uses EmailStr which could leak which emails are syntactically valid vs invalid (422 vs 400). Low-risk, standard FastAPI behaviour.
forgot-password rate limits use limiter.take (reserves a slot on every call), so even unknown emails consume the per-IP quota - correct, otherwise attackers could probe emails without cost.
privacy_sections dynamically rebuilds from firm doc on every GET. Fine for now (one Mongo read via adviser_profile(default_adviser())); consider caching if traffic grows.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added `source: str = ""` to Lead model to fix 500 on /api/adviser/leads)

success_rate.frontend: testID smoke pass (auth-forgot-password, forgot-password-screen, forgot-email-input, forgot-send-code, auth-privacy-checkbox, auth-open-privacy, privacy-screen with SFL + Rosemount text all present)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. All TEST_* users (~15 during the run) + their leads removed; db.rate_limits and db.password_resets cleared at teardown. Mark + Tom passwords and password_versions unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (6 classes, 19 tests, ~10s under xdist loadscope). To exercise forgot/reset without email delivery, insert your own password_resets doc keyed by user_id with code_hash = sha256(f'{JWT_SECRET}:{user_id}:{code}').hexdigest() (JWT_SECRET from backend/.env). Rate limits: forgot-password is 3/email/hour + 10/IP/hour; use a unique X-Forwarded-For per request and clear db.rate_limits in teardown. Registrations now REQUIRE 'privacy_accepted': true and leads REQUIRE 'consent': true (older tests have been updated). Known billing/sandbox state: outbound email returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for mark.turner@sflwealth.co.uk; this is handled by the server (logged, response still 200). Frontend testIDs for iteration 6: forgot-password-screen, forgot-{email-input,code-input,new-password,confirm-password,send-code,reset-submit,resend,back,info,error}; privacy-screen, privacy-{back,error}; firm-dashboard-screen, firm-dashboard-{back,error}, firm-total-{clients,checks,leads,new,contacted,closed}, firm-adviser-row-${code}, firm-lead-sources; adviser-firm-dashboard-button (on Mark Home); auth-{forgot-password,privacy-checkbox,open-privacy}; adviser-{consent-checkbox,privacy-link,submit-button,error} on the adviser tab. BUG FIXED THIS RUN: /api/adviser/leads was 500 when any lead existed because Lead pydantic model lacked a `source` field - fixed by adding `source: str = ""`. If regressions arise around lead attribution, check Lead.to_mongo output and backfill if needed.
rca_of_issue: 500 on GET /api/adviser/leads: server.py:720 lead_out() reads `lead.source`, but Lead (BaseDocument) at lines 165-181 had no `source` attribute. The constructor call at line 676 passed `source=user.signup_source` which pydantic silently dropped (default extra='ignore'), so `lead.source` raised AttributeError and FastAPI returned 500. Reproduction: Mark logs in -> GET /api/adviser/leads -> 500 as soon as >=1 lead exists for him. Mitigation applied: added `source: str = ""` to Lead model. Backend restarted via supervisor. Verified by re-running all 19 iteration-6 tests - 100% pass including TestRegression::test_mark_leads_and_stats which previously failed with 500.
